MINUTES OF MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN VENTURE ONE
(PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON THE 13TH DAY OF MAY 2019
Present
Imran Ali Khan
Zeeshan Ali Khan

Director / Chief Executive
Director

Imran Ali Khan chaired the meeting (“Chairman”).
Agenda
ISSUE OF ORDINARY SHARES
The Board was informed that the Company desires to issue and allot ordinary shares of Rs. 10
(Rupees Ten) each of the Company against the Pakistani Rupees equivalent of AED 1,250,000
(Emirati Dirham one million two hundred fifty thousand) (“Shares”). It was proposed that the
Shares be offered to the existing shareholders in accordance with the requirements of Sections
76 of the Companies Act, 2017 and the rules thereunder, which offer would remain open until 4
June 2019. It was further proposed that any Shares not taken up or renounced by the existing
shareholders may be sold to any person, including EMPG Projects Holdings Limited.
The Board unanimously nominated Imran Ali Khan for giving effect to the aforementioned
transaction.
Resolutions
After discussing the aforesaid matters
passed/approved/adopted by the Board:

in

detail,

the

following

resolutions

were

1. Resolved by the Board that the existing shareholders of the Company be offered the Shares
in accordance with the provisions of Section 76 of the Companies Act, 2017 and the rules
thereunder, which offer shall remain open for acceptance until 4 June 2019; and if the offer
is not accepted or replied to by the existing shareholders on or before the date aforesaid, the
offer be deemed to have been declined.
2. Resolved further by the Board that Imran Ali Khan is hereby authorized and empowered to
do and execute all such acts, deeds and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the
aforementioned transaction.
